versos.texto_bv: E o homem deu nomes a todo animal, e às aves dos céus, e a todo animal do campo; mas para o homem não se achou auxiliadora que lhe correspondesse.
versos.traducao_literal: E chamou o homem nomes a todo o gado, e à ave dos céus, e a todo animal do campo; mas para o homem não achou auxiliadora como o seu correspondente.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): A BV verte הַבְּהֵמָה (H929, 'gado/animais domésticos') como 'todo animal', colidindo com 'todo animal do campo' (חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה, H2416c) no mesmo verso: a enumeração fica redundante e ilógica em português ('todo animal' já conteria 'todo animal do campo') e a distinção lexical do hebraico desaparece. A cura gramatical da redundância exigiria restaurar 'gado' (ou equivalente) na primeira posição — mudança de sentido lexical, fora do escopo desta revisão. — evidência: traducao_literal: 'a todo o gado, e à ave dos céus, e a todo animal do campo'; KJV: 'all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field'; morfologia pinada distingue הַבְּהֵמָה (H929) de חַיַּת (H2416c) — dois lexemas, uma só glosa no publicado.

kjv.texto: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

vizinhos.19: And out of the ground the Lord God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
vizinhos.21: And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

web.texto: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

vizinhos.19: Out of the ground Yahweh God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.
vizinhos.21: Yahweh God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
